criteria.text: The participant is ≥18 years old, except for Phase 2 Cohort 2f where they must be ≥12 years and weigh >40 kg, and for DDI sub-study Cohorts G and H where they must be 18-60 years old, inclusive.
The participant has a histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with a documented ALK rearrangement or activating ALK mutation.
The participant has a histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with a documented ALK rearrangement.
The participant has a histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with a documented ALK rearrangement or activating ALK mutation detected by certified assay.
The participant has a histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with a documented ALK rearrangement.
The participant has previously received ≥1 ALK TKI, has not received prior investigational agents targeting ALK, and may have received any number of prior chemotherapy and/or immunotherapy.
The participant has evaluable disease (target or nontarget) according to RECIST 1.1 in Phase 1, or measurable disease according to RECIST 1.1 in Phase 2.
The participant has adequate organ function and bone marrow reserve.
The participant's cancer has a known oncogenic driver alteration other than ALK.
The participant has a known allergy or hypersensitivity to excipients of NVL-655.
The participant has undergone major surgery within 4 weeks of the study entry.
The participant is currently receiving ongoing or anticancer therapy.
The participant is actively receiving systemic treatment or direct medical intervention on another therapeutic clinical study.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "A Study of Neladalkib (NVL-655) in Patients With Advanced NSCLC and Other Solid Tumors Harboring ALK Rearrangement or Activating ALK Mutation (ALKOVE-1)". Your earlier answers already covered 3 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: How old are you?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you been told that your tumor has an ALK rearrangement or an activating ALK mutation? (These are specific genetic changes in the cancer cells.)

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: My son might know. I don't.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever taken a medicine called an ALK TKI (a type of targeted therapy for ALK-positive cancer)? If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't. I haven't had any targeted therapy pills yet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever taken part in a research study or trial for a new medicine that targets ALK?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't. They only just found it, so I haven't had any treatments yet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you had recent blood tests (like a complete blood count and chemistry panel) to check that your organs and bone marrow are functioning well?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. My son helps with the paperwork, but I'm not sure about the recent blood tests.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks for letting me know. Since your son helps with the paperwork, would he be able to check if you've had recent blood tests to confirm your organs and bone marrow are functioning well?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. My son might know, but I'm not sure about the recent blood tests.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any known allergies or hypersensitivities to the inactive ingredients (excipients) found in the study medication NVL-655?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. I've never heard of that medicine or its ingredients.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you had any major surgery in the last 4 weeks?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any major surgery recently.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are you currently receiving any cancer treatments, such as chemotherapy, radiation, or immunotherapy?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No treatment yet. They only just found it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
